column3: 翔竜山の麓に到着する
column4: Arrive at the foot of Mt. Shoryuu.

column3: 高い・・・標高は１２０００メートルと言われている
column4: So high... it's said to have an altitude of 12,000 meters.

column3: ランスは過去に１回登った事がある、その話題
column4: Rance has climbed it once before; conversation about that.

column3: 歴史上登った者は誰もいないとされているので快挙、ミラクルも褒める
column4: Since no one is said to have climbed it in history, it's an achievement; Miracle compliments him.

column3: あの時も大変だったが、今回も登るぞ
column4: It was tough last time too, but we'll climb it again this time.
